tools.name: estimate_home_cleaning_cost
tools.description: Use this when a user wants a free planning estimate for cleaning a US house, apartment, condo, or townhouse. Returns price range, labor hours, crew size, duration, assumptions, and a visual report. Do not present it as a binding quote.

tools.name: estimate_office_cleaning_cost
tools.description: Use this when a user wants a free office or commercial cleaning budget estimate in the United States. Returns per-visit and monthly ranges, labor, crew, schedule assumptions, and a visual report. Do not use for residential cleaning or present it as a binding bid.

tools.name: estimate_cleaning_time_and_crew
tools.description: Use this when a user asks how long a cleaning job may take or how many cleaners are needed. Works for homes, apartments, offices, retail, and vacation rentals. It estimates workload, not worker availability or a price quote.

tools.name: calculate_cleaning_chemical_usage
tools.description: Use this when a user needs a planning estimate for ready-to-use cleaning solution, concentrate, water, or generic container quantities across one or many jobs. It does not recommend brands and product-label directions always take precedence.
